location: Golden Fry fast-food kitchen, grill station
action: Cody, flipping burger patties at the grill under a vent hood, asks his boss for a half day off to attend the Gods of Metal rock show. The boss stands nearby holding two drink cups, glowering.
visual_prompt: A fast-food kitchen with a vent hood over a flat grill: at center, a droopy-eyed young man with a huge nose, stringy shoulder-length hair under a folded paper service hat, in a sleeveless work top and shorts, extends a spatula with a burger patty over the grill; at right, an older angular man with a sharp beak-like nose and a sour scowl, also in a folded paper hat and work shirt, holds a drink cup in each hand. Title lettering across the top. Medium two-shot, eye level.

dialogue.speaker: cody
dialogue.line: BOSS MAN, I WAS THINKIN OF TAKING A HALF DAY.  THE 'GODS OF METAL' ROCK SHEOW IS HAPPENIN TODAY. IM TEWTOLLY STEWKED!

performance: Oblivious slacker optimism versus simmering managerial contempt

action: The boss erupts at Cody face-to-face, jabbing a drink cup toward him while delivering a furious tirade about the restaurant's mission and Cody's burned burgers, ending with a threat to his job.
visual_prompt: Tight two-shot in a fast-food kitchen: at right, an older angular man with a sharp beak-like nose, folded paper hat, and a sleeveless work top leans in shouting, thrusting a drink cup with a straw toward the other man while clutching a second cup; at left, a droopy young man with a huge nose and stringy dark hair under a paper hat recoils slightly, deflated and hangdog. Dense angry lettering fills the upper half of the frame. Close two-shot, eye level.

dialogue.speaker: boss_man
dialogue.line: NO NOTICE AND YOU WANT A HALF DAY??! WELL OUR CUSTOMERS' HUNGER DOESNT TAKE A HALF DAY! OUR MISSION IS TO SERVE HOT DELICIOUS AND FRESH FOOD, AND YOU'VE ALREADY BURNED AND RUINED BURGERS! LONG STORY SHORT, YOU'RE NOT GOING ANYWHERE IF YOU WANT TO STAY EMPLOYED AT GOLDEN FRY! YOU'RE ON THIN ICE, SHITHEAD!

location: Golden Fry fast-food kitchen, grill smoking
action: Later, Cody sulks at the grill — flames and smoke rising off the patties — as his short bowl-cut friend appears at the door, thumbing over his shoulder and urging him to sneak out during his lunch break for the rock show. Cody brightens at the idea.
visual_prompt: A fast-food kitchen: at center, a long-nosed young man with stringy dark hair under a folded paper hat pokes a spatula at a flat grill where patties smolder with rising flames and smoke curls; at far right, a short stocky kid with a pale bowl haircut covering his eyes, in a black band t-shirt, baggy shorts and heavy black boots, jerks a thumb over his shoulder. dialogue.speaker: friend
dialogue.line: YOU GAWT A LONCH BREAK, RIGHT? SNEAK OUT FOR A HOUR!

dialogue.speaker: cody
dialogue.line: A HOUR HUH? I CAN GET SOME RAWK IN!

location: Street outside the Golden Fry restaurant
action: Cody and his friend sprint away from the Golden Fry storefront in silhouette, whooping about how stoked they are, leaving the restaurant — and the grill — behind.
visual_prompt: Daytime street scene: two silhouetted figures sprint left away from a fast-food restaurant at right whose big hand-lettered sign reads GOLDEN FRY with a cheerful dancing fry-cup mascot; the leading runner is stocky with flying hair, the trailing runner lanky in a paper hat with a long apron flapping; low skyline and a single cloud behind. Wide shot, eye level, strong left-to-right motion away from the building.

location: Gods of Metal rock show, inside the crowd
action: At the rock show, a shirtless Cody throws both arms up flashing devil-horn hand signs, blissed out, while his friend pumps a fist overhead, head bowed and rocking, a studded bracelet on his wrist, amid a sea of bobbing crowd heads.

location: Venue exit, rope line outside the rock show
action: Three hours later, a sweat-drenched shirtless Cody staggers out past the rope line with his friend, suddenly remembering — out loud — that he left burgers on the grill and has to get back to work.
visual_prompt: Outside a concert venue with a riveted wall and a single rope stanchion barrier: a short stocky kid with a pale bowl haircut, black t-shirt, shorts and heavy black boots strides ahead at left; behind him a scrawny shirtless young man with a huge nose and stringy soaked hair staggers forward dripping sweat, a wisp of smoke curling from the cigarette in his hand, wearing knee-length shorts and sneakers. location: Street outside the Golden Fry restaurant, now on fire
action: Cody and his friend, seen in silhouette from behind, arrive to find the Golden Fry engulfed — two massive columns of black smoke and flames pour from the building while the tiny figure of the boss stands at the door swearing. END card in the corner.
